participant_notice.zh: 本研究希望了解人们如何观察植物的季节性状态和变化，而不是测试您的植物学知识。您可以回答“不确定”或“看不出可靠变化”，带有“不愿回答”选项的题目可选择该选项，选答题可留空；您也可以随时停止参与。请依次完成各部分，不要提前查看后面的任务。
participant_notice.en: We seek to understand how people observe seasonal plant conditions and changes, not test botanical knowledge. You may answer “I am unsure” or “I cannot see a reliable change,” use “Prefer not to answer” where offered, leave optional questions blank, or stop participating at any time. Please complete the sections in order without looking ahead.

fields.zh: 您的年龄范围是？
fields.en: What is your age range?

fields.zh: 您的专业、学习领域或工作领域是什么？（选答）
fields.en: What is your major, field of study, or area of work? (Optional)

fields.zh: 您是否接受过与植物、生态、园艺或环境科学相关的课程或培训？
fields.en: Have you taken courses or training related to plants, ecology, horticulture, or environmental science?

fields.zh: 您照料或种植植物的频率如何？（选答）
fields.en: How often do you grow or care for plants? (Optional)

fields.zh: 您平时主动观察身边植物或季节变化的频率如何？（选答）
fields.en: How often do you actively observe plants or seasonal changes around you? (Optional)

fields.zh: 您是否使用过植物识别应用或 AI 工具来了解植物？（选答）
fields.en: Have you used a plant identification app or AI tool to learn about plants? (Optional)

fields.zh: 若使用过，您通常希望得到什么信息？（选答）
fields.en: If so, what information were you usually looking for? (Optional)

instructions.zh: 请先独立观察整株植物，并先描述直接可见的证据，再说明这些证据是否可能与植物的季节性状态或变化有关。可以留意芽、叶、花、果实或衰老迹象，但不必假定任何特征一定存在，也不必判断具体季节。
instructions.en: First observe the whole plant independently. Describe directly visible evidence before explaining whether it might relate to the plant’s seasonal condition or change. You may consider buds, leaves, flowers, fruits, or signs of senescence, without assuming any feature is present or naming a particular season.

fields.zh: 观察这株植物时，您首先注意到哪些可能与季节变化有关的特征？
fields.en: When observing this plant, what features that might be related to seasonal changes did you notice first?

fields.zh: 如果想进一步了解这株植物的季节性状态或变化，您会继续查看哪里？为什么？
fields.en: If you wanted to understand the plant’s seasonal condition or change better, where would you look next, and why?

fields.zh: 您关注了哪些具体可见特征（例如芽、叶、花、果实或衰老迹象）？为什么觉得这些特征可能有帮助？
fields.en: Which specific visible features—such as buds, leaves, flowers, fruits, or signs of senescence—did you attend to? Why might they be useful?

fields.zh: 您是否改变过观察距离、角度或位置？如果有，是什么可见内容让您决定这么做？
fields.en: Did you change your viewing distance, angle, or position? If so, what visible evidence led you to do that?

fields.zh: 根据目前可见的证据，您能对植物的季节性状态或变化作出哪些判断？哪些地方仍不能确定？
fields.en: Based on the visible evidence, what can you conclude about the plant’s seasonal condition or change, and what remains uncertain?

fields.zh: 把握程度
fields.en: Confidence

closing.zh: 没有预设唯一正确的观察位置；“不确定”或“证据还不够”也是合理回答。
closing.en: There is no single required observation area; “I am unsure” or “there is not enough evidence” is a valid response.

title.en: Temporal Comparison of Seasonal Plant Change

instructions.zh: 请独立比较同一株植物在两个时间点的资料。先描述直接可见的相同与不同，再说明这些证据是否可能反映芽、叶、花、果实或衰老等季节性变化。系统不会预先告诉您是否真的发生了变化。
instructions.en: Independently compare the same plant at two time points. First describe visible similarities and differences, then explain whether the evidence might reflect seasonal changes in buds, leaves, flowers, fruits, or senescence. The system will not tell you whether a change actually occurred.

fields.zh: 两份材料在芽、叶、花、果实、颜色或衰老迹象等可见特征上有哪些相同或不同？如果看不出可靠变化，也可以直接说明。
fields.en: What visible similarities or differences do you notice in buds, leaves, flowers, fruits, color, or signs of senescence? You may say if no reliable change is apparent.

fields.zh: 您的判断依据是什么？请先指出对应位置或描述具体可见特征。
fields.en: What evidence supports your judgment? First point to the relevant area or describe the specific visible features.

fields.zh: 您是怎样比较两个时间点的？有没有特别回看或反复检查的季节性特征？
fields.en: How did you compare the two time points? Were there seasonal features you revisited or checked repeatedly?

fields.zh: 这些可见线索可能说明哪些季节性状态或变化？哪些解释目前还不够确定？
fields.en: What seasonal conditions or changes might these visible cues indicate? Which interpretations remain uncertain?

fields.zh: 您对刚才判断的把握程度如何？
fields.en: How confident are you in the judgment you just made?

fields.zh: 如果可以再检查一个地方或获得一份额外材料，您最想检查什么季节性证据？
fields.en: If you could inspect one more area or obtain one additional piece of information, what seasonal evidence would you most want to check?

instructions.zh: 请按自己的方式独立观察新材料。先描述直接可见的芽、叶、花、果实或衰老迹象，再说明它们是否可能反映植物的季节性状态；也请说明哪些内容不能确认。本阶段不提供系统提示或参考答案。
instructions.en: Examine the new material independently in your own way. First describe directly visible buds, leaves, flowers, fruits, or signs of senescence, then explain whether they might reflect the plant’s seasonal condition and what cannot be confirmed. No system hints or reference answers are provided.

fields.zh: 观察这张图片时，您注意到了哪些可能反映植物季节性状态的特征？有哪些地方让您感到不确定？
fields.en: What features did you notice that might indicate the plant's seasonal condition? Was anything unclear or uncertain?

fields.zh: 刚才有没有某个时刻让您对可见证据或季节性判断感到困难或犹豫？当时您做了什么？
fields.en: Was there a moment when you felt unsure about the visible evidence or a seasonal interpretation? What did you do then?

fields.zh: 仔细观察之后，您对这株植物季节性状态的最初想法有没有变化？如果有，哪些可见证据让您改变了想法？
fields.en: After looking more carefully, did your initial impression of the plant’s seasonal condition change? If so, what visible evidence changed your mind?

fields.zh: 如果想进一步了解或确认这株植物的季节性状态，您还希望观察什么，或者获得什么额外信息？
fields.en: To better understand or confirm the plant’s seasonal condition, what else would you like to observe or what additional information would you need?

fields.zh: 您对目前关于这株植物的判断有多大把握？
fields.en: How confident are you in your current judgment about this plant?

fields.zh: 在刚才的观察过程中，您最希望在哪个时候获得帮助？为什么？如果不需要帮助，也可以直接说明。
fields.en: During the observation task, at what point would you have most wanted help, and why? If you did not need any help, you may say so.

fields.zh: 如果可以获得帮助，您希望得到什么样的帮助？如果不需要帮助，也可以直接说明。
fields.en: If help had been available, what kind of help would you have wanted? You may also say if you did not need any help.

closing.zh: 不确定是允许的回答；本阶段不会显示提示、正确答案或判断反馈。
closing.en: Uncertainty is an acceptable response; this phase does not show hints, correct answers, or judgment feedback.

instructions.zh: 请回想刚才在 B、C 和 D 部分完成的独立植物观察任务，并根据自己的真实经历回答。没有标准答案，您可以说明某个经历发生在哪一部分。
instructions.en: Please reflect on the independent plant-observation tasks you completed in Sections B, C, and D and answer from your own experience. There are no right or wrong answers; you may indicate which section you are referring to.

fields.zh: 回想 B、C 和 D 的观察任务，哪个具体时刻让您觉得最困难或最不确定？为什么？
fields.en: Looking back at the observation tasks in B, C, and D, which specific moment did you find most difficult or uncertain, and why?

fields.zh: 在刚才提到的困难时刻，如果可以获得帮助，您最希望得到什么样的帮助？为什么？如果不需要帮助，也可以直接说明。
fields.en: At the difficult moment you just described, what kind of help would you have wanted, and why? You may also say if you did not need any help.

fields.zh: 您希望观察工具在什么时候提供帮助？（请选择最接近的选项。）
fields.en: When would you prefer an observation tool to offer help? (Choose the closest option.)

options.zh: 工具先询问我是否需要帮助
options.en: When the tool first asks if I need help

options.zh: 当工具发现我遇到困难时
options.en: When the tool detects that I am having difficulty

fields.zh: 为什么？
fields.en: Why?

fields.zh: 您觉得在什么情况下，观察工具提供的提示可能会打断您的观察，或者影响您自己作出判断？
fields.en: In what situations might prompts from an observation tool interrupt your observation or affect your ability to make your own judgment?
